source_refs.note: Exercise 5.2, Question 10 (book p. 158); answer key PDF 306

blocks.prompt: 10 The coordinates of the points are \(A(0, \lambda)\), \(B(-2, 1)\) and \(C(-3, -2)\). By computing the area bounded by \(ABC\), find the value of \(\lambda\) if points are collinear.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Question 9 ka ulta roop hai: wahan points diye the aur collinearity check karni thi; yahan collinear hona diya hai aur ek coordinate \(\lambda\) maloom karna hai.
Collinear points ka area zero hota hai, is liye \(\Delta = 0\) rakhenge.
Area mein \(\lambda\) aayega, aur \(\Delta = 0\) ki equation hal karne se \(\lambda\) mil jayega.
Plan: area \(\lambda\) mein, zero ke barabar, hal.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(A(0, \lambda)\), \(B(-2, 1)\), \(C(-3, -2)\) collinear hain.
Maloom karna: \(\lambda\).
Tareeqa: 5.7 ka Corollary: collinear \(\Leftrightarrow \Delta = 0\).

\(\lambda\) mein area
\[\Delta = \tfrac{1}{2}\big[0(1 + 2) + (-2)(-2 - \lambda)\]
\[+ (-3)(\lambda - 1)\big]\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}[4 + 2\lambda - 3\lambda + 3]\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}(7 - \lambda)\]
Kyun: \(x_1(y_2 - y_3) + x_2(y_3 - y_1) + x_3(y_1 - y_2)\) mein \(y_1 = \lambda\) rakha. \((-2)(-2 - \lambda) = 4 + 2\lambda\) aur \((-3)(\lambda - 1) = -3\lambda + 3\).
Dhyan dein: negative ko bracket ke andar har term se multiply karein; \(-3 \times -1 = +3\) bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

\(\Delta = 0\) rakhein
\[\tfrac{1}{2}(7 - \lambda) = 0\]
\[\lambda = 7\]
Kyun: points collinear hain, is liye area zero; \(\frac{1}{2}\) zero nahi, to \(7 - \lambda = 0\).

Tasdeeq:
\(A(0, 7)\) le kar:
\[m_{AB} = \dfrac{1 - 7}{-2 - 0} = 3\]
\[m_{BC} = \dfrac{-2 - 1}{-3 + 2} = 3\]
Slopes barabar, is liye teeno points ek line par hain \(\checkmark\)
Do tareeqon se ek hi jawab: area wala aur slope wala. Isi tarah exam mein bhi apna jawab check kar sakte hain.
